lines.t: Elect and precious, elect and precious
For I know my own, says the Lord
Elect and precious, elect and precious
For I know my own, says the Lord
You are more than the field that covers you
More than the sin that fills you
Much more than the choices you make for us
See your beauty, I know your heart
And the love which you have for me
For I know my heart says the Lord
In acting precious, in acting precious
For I know my own self is the Lord
Elected and precious
In the name of Christ the Lord
Behold, I know you as you are
And will be with me where I am
You are not that which you choose
In a moment of weakness
You are that which I have created
And will become the rich I restore
And will remain always a beautiful finished work
Elected precious, my everlasting treasure
Even as I shall be yours also
For I know my own says the Lord
Elected precious, elected precious
For I know my own says the Lord
I like the pressure, I like the pressure
My everlasting treasure, even as I shall be yours also
